title: JSW MG Motor India Posts Record July Sales as EVs Cross 80% of Volume
excerpt: The automaker dispatched 8,158 units in July 2026, up 22% year-on-year, with electric vehicles now accounting for more than four-fifths of total wholesale figures.
body:
• JSW MG Motor India reported 8,158 wholesale units in July 2026, a 22% year-on-year increase and the company's highest-ever monthly figure
  • Electric vehicles now contribute over 80% of total sales, up from 75% in June, cementing MG's position as one of India's most EV-heavy automakers
  • The record marks the second consecutive month of all-time-high dispatches, following 7,568 units in June 2026

JSW MG Motor India set a new monthly wholesale record in July 2026, dispatching 8,158 units to dealers across the country. The figure represents a 22 percent year-on-year increase over the roughly 6,690 units the company sold in July 2025, and marks the second straight month the Gurugram-headquartered automaker has posted its highest-ever wholesale number.

Electric vehicles drove the bulk of that volume. According to the company, EVs now account for more than 80 percent of total sales — a threshold MG crossed for the first time, up from the 75 percent share recorded in June 2026.

"Our performance in July is a reflection of the growing confidence that customers have placed in our brand. This strong performance, coupled with another month of robust retail sales, demonstrates the strength of our diverse portfolio and our ability to meet evolving customer aspirations."

— Anurag Mehrotra, Managing Director, JSW MG Motor India

The Windsor EV Engine Room

The MG Windsor EV remains the single largest contributor to the company's numbers. The electric crossover crossed 75,000 cumulative sales in under two years since launch and sold more than 19,000 units in the first half of calendar year 2026 alone, according to company data. Its Battery-as-a-Service pricing — starting at ₹9.99 lakh with a per-kilometre battery charge — has attracted first-time EV buyers, particularly in non-metro cities where MG says 70 percent of Windsor orders originate.

The broader EV lineup, including the Comet EV city car, ZS EV midsize SUV, Cyberster roadster and M9 luxury MPV, rounds out a portfolio that gives JSW MG one of the widest electric ranges in the Indian market. ICE models such as the Hector, Gloster and the recently launched Majestor flagship SUV continue to draw buyers, though their share of the overall mix has narrowed as EV adoption accelerates.

Growth Trajectory and Competitive Context

July's record caps a strong run for JSW MG. The company posted 7,568 wholesale units in June 2026, itself a record at the time, representing 30 percent year-on-year growth. In the full fiscal year 2025-26, MG's EV sales jumped 66 percent to 62,591 units, according to data reported by The Hindu BusinessLine.

The numbers remain modest compared to India's largest passenger vehicle makers. Tata Motors reported 63,760 units in July 2026, a 59 percent year-on-year surge, with its EV dispatches alone reaching 15,217 units — nearly double MG's total volume. Mahindra & Mahindra sold 60,048 SUVs, up 20 percent. But MG's EV concentration — over 80 percent of sales versus Tata's roughly 24 percent — positions it as a bellwether for India's electric transition.

Mehrotra highlighted MG ADAPT, a flexible ownership programme, as part of the company's strategy to lower barriers to EV adoption. Rising fuel prices and continued geopolitical uncertainty affecting global energy markets have also tilted consumer sentiment toward electric options, the company said.

What's Next

JSW MG is expected to expand its new energy vehicle lineup further in the second half of 2026. The company has already begun deliveries of the Majestor, a D-plus segment SUV powered by a 2.0-litre twin-turbo diesel, and launched a plug-in hybrid model based on the Starlight platform in July. With EV share crossing 80 percent and monthly volumes at a record, sustaining momentum will depend on production capacity, charging infrastructure expansion and whether the Windsor can maintain its dominance against rising competition from Tata's Nexon EV, Mahindra's BE 6, and Maruti Suzuki's e Vitara.
nri_angle: JSW MG's EV-heavy sales mix signals accelerating electrification in India's auto market, a trend reshaping the industry landscape for global investors and diaspora observers.
